spec.function_description: Add a column to a family table, based on a dimension or a parameter of the model.  The cells of all instances accept the default value of the column; use set_cell to change them

request.name: file
request.description: File name of the generic model

request.name: name
request.description: Name of a dimension, dimension ID (d#), or name of a parameter

request.name: coltype
request.default: A dimension of that name is tried first, then a parameter

response.name: colid
response.description: Column ID of the new column
